name: Luth-LFM2-1.2B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2-1.2B (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. Full fine-tune of LiquidAI/LFM2-1.2B on the Luth-SFT dataset by kurakurai with Liquid AI, trained in Axolotl and then merged back into the base weights - a merged model, not an adapter, and the repo ships model.safetensors (1.17B) plus a config, so it is runnable as its own checkpoint. Config is the base's (hidden 2048, 16 layers, 32 heads / 8 KV heads). flops_per_token_active is the base record's own 2.34e9 (2 x 1.17B active); the generator's 6x-active default was overridden for the same reason as the Ramen-CHORD record - see PR #466. Recorded because the card prints 'Luth-LFM2-1.2B' and 'LFM2-1.2B' rows in the SAME French table and the SAME English table, with LightEval at temperature=0, and Luth wins 8 of the 12 columns. It is not a clean sweep and the losses are recorded here rather than hidden: Arc-Challenge French 38.98 vs 39.44 and MMLU English 54.58 vs 55.22. The French gains are the real content of the card (IFEval +5.5, GPQA-Diamond +6.1, Math500 +9.0); the English rows are the 'did not forget' check and move by 1-5 points in both directions. French benchmarks are the authors' own custom LightEval tasks, so they are not comparable to anyone else's French numbers. Licence is LFM Open License v1.0 (other), repo created 2025-08-22.
